pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seeded rows are 0 and the CHECK rejects 2.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in order.
test/done.test.js 'AC-3' checks done-only, ✓ prefix, id order (marks 3 then 1).
test/done.test.js 'AC-4' checks all items, ✓ only on done ones.
test/done.test.js 'AC-5' checks the exact nav for each view and for /.
test/done.test.js 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty, __proto__.

Behaviour is implemented in src/index.js and tested, but the last commit (1e16aa4 'Follow-up edits') removed 'AC-7:' from the test title. No test names AC-7 now and the spec doesn't mark it verified by review, so it counts as unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists both; test/done.test.js 'AC-8' asserts them.

findings.what: The commit 'Follow-up edits' renamed the AC-7 test to 'an empty table says so in every view; an empty view has its own message', so no test names AC-7. The file header says each test names the acceptance item it proves, and the PR says the file covers AC-1 to AC-8.
The PR claims test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8, but AC-7 is no longer named in any test.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-7 name, which makes the claim true.

lenses.note: The spec has a go and decisions. The code follows both: it opens on the open items, and the view is a query parameter.
7 of 8 acceptance items are met. AC-7 is unnamed in the tests after the last commit. All six state rows have tests.

The tests assert behaviour. I did not run them; CI runs them on every push. The traffic test's fake app was extended and no existing test was loosened. A deleted test or a hidden fixture dependency is not visible in the diff.
README describes the views. Nothing stale.
Object.hasOwn guards __proto__, SQL fragments come only from the fixed VIEWS table, and the empty-table check is correct.
Query input is validated against a whitelist, titles are HTML-escaped, and no instructions are planted in the repository.
The change touches the HTML in src/index.js but adds no new screens. The nav is plain, with a non-link current view.
The page changes. Behaviour is covered by the Worker tests, and no browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters. The claim that done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8 is not true of the final tree for AC-7.
